title: Establish a channel or commercial partnership
summary: When another organization may refer, resell, integrate or jointly deliver the company's product. An approved partnership agreement, tested operating handoffs and an owned performance review.
outcomes: An approved partnership agreement, tested operating handoffs and an owned performance review.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When another organization may refer, resell, integrate or jointly deliver the company's product.

parts.title: Define the partnership model and economics
parts.guidance: Describe the target customers, roles, referral or resale flow, economics and delivery dependencies. Separate a co-marketing arrangement from authority to sell, bind or represent the company.

parts.title: Review the partner and commercial risks
parts.guidance: Verify the counterparty and assess capability, conflicts, data sharing and market fit. Counsel reviews agency, competition, tax and local restrictions for the actual arrangement.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

approval.scope: Review the partner and commercial risks

parts.title: Prepare the operating and agreement terms
parts.guidance: Draft lead ownership, customer support, payments, branding, data access, success measures and termination handoffs. Identify which responsibilities stay with the company and which the partner can perform.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

parts.title: Approve the agreement and pilot
parts.guidance: Authorized parties execute the reviewed terms and approve a bounded initial test. Confirm training and access before enabling customer introductions or delegated selling rights.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

parts.title: Review results and reconcile obligations
parts.guidance: Match leads, revenue, commissions and customer issues to the agreement. Resolve disputes through the named owners and decide whether to continue, revise or terminate with a controlled customer handover.
